negative_results.result: Naive full-candidate HDC decode exceeded practical experimental budget.
negative_results.consequence: HDC must use bounded candidate decode or is rejected for hot path.

negative_results.result: HDC/VSA recall materially degrades with superposition load.
negative_results.consequence: NOT_SELECTED as exact primary relation store.

negative_results.result: Product-key retrieval on deliberately non-product data achieved 0 recall.
negative_results.consequence: PKM cannot be universal retrieval; manifold/admissibility gate and fallback mandatory.

negative_results.result: Adaptive PKM router at 32k could preserve recall yet be slower than brute scan.
negative_results.consequence: Do not activate learned route below measured crossover.

negative_results.result: Repeated router sweeps showed timing variance and some false routes under naive threshold calibration.
negative_results.consequence: No performance promotion; require target workload calibration, OOD drift test, and fail-safe fallback.

negative_results.result: Graph ANN literature contains constructed instances with near-linear search behavior.
negative_results.consequence: ANN field is derived accelerator only; adversarial/OOD exact fallback remains mandatory.

negative_results.result: A finite-sample/IID RouteValidityCertificate that satisfied a 0.5% target risk was catastrophically invalid under a constructed same-index tail distribution shift: all 22 routed shifted queries disagreed with the exact reference.
negative_results.consequence: Certificate validity must be scoped and revocable. Index/epoch/hash binding alone is insufficient for query-distribution shift; online exact-shadow risk sentinels, drift tripwires, quarantine and deterministic fallback are mandatory for learned accelerators.
